content: Vedant Thakur called Neha Kapoor to discuss his expired auto policy (#AV-45231). Neha explained the 30-day reinstatement process, which involves paying backdated premiums and a $15 admin fee without any penalties. They also discussed a new quote with a loyalty discount, and after adjusting the deductible to $500 to lower the annual premium to $1,130, Vedant opted to process the reinstatement immediately using the credit card on file.

action_items: Process policy reinstatement using the credit card on file
Send a confirmation email to the customer
